```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

find_up <- function(rel_path, start = getwd(), max_levels = 8) {
  d <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  for (i in 0:max_levels) {
    cand <- file.path(d, rel_path)
    if (file.exists(cand)) return(cand)
    parent <- dirname(d)
    if (identical(parent, d)) break
    d <- parent
  }
  NA_character_
}

nz <- function(x) {
  !is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

safe_html <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | trimws(x) == ""] <- "—"
  htmltools::htmlEscape(x)
}

slugify <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | trimws(x) == ""] <- "expedicao"
  x <- iconv(x, from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", x)
  x <- gsub("(^-+|-+$)", "", x)
  x[x == ""] <- "expedicao"
  make.unique(x, sep = "-")
}

clean_photo_folder <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  x <- gsub("\u00A0", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "/", x)
  x <- gsub("^\\./+", "", x)
  x <- gsub("^/+|/+$", "", x)
  x <- gsub("^_input_data/expedicoes_fotos/+", "", x)
  x <- gsub("^expedicoes_fotos/+", "", x)
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  x
}
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function(){
  function initExpeditionCarousels(){
    const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.expedition-card'));

    function stopCarousel(carousel){
      if(carousel && carousel._tsiinoTimer){
        window.clearInterval(carousel._tsiinoTimer);
        carousel._tsiinoTimer = null;
      }
    }

    function goTo(carousel, index){
      if(!carousel) return;
      const slides = Array.from(carousel.querySelectorAll('.exp-slide'));
      if(!slides.length) return;

      const n = slides.length;
      const idx = ((index % n) + n) % n;
      carousel.dataset.index = String(idx);

      const track = carousel.querySelector('.exp-carousel-track');
      if(track){
        track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (idx * 100) + '%)';
      }

      carousel.querySelectorAll('.exp-carousel-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
        dot.classList.toggle('is-current', i === idx);
        dot.setAttribute('aria-current', i === idx ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
    }

    function startCarousel(carousel){
      if(!carousel || carousel.dataset.single === 'true') return;
      stopCarousel(carousel);
      carousel._tsiinoTimer = window.setInterval(() => {
        const current = Number(carousel.dataset.index || '0');
        goTo(carousel, current + 1);
      }, 4200);
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.exp-carousel').forEach(carousel => {
      goTo(carousel, 0);

      const prev = carousel.querySelector('.exp-carousel-prev');
      const next = carousel.querySelector('.exp-carousel-next');

      if(prev){
        prev.addEventListener('click', () => {
          goTo(carousel, Number(carousel.dataset.index || '0') - 1);
          if(carousel.closest('.expedition-card')?.classList.contains('is-active')) startCarousel(carousel);
        });
      }

      if(next){
        next.addEventListener('click', () => {
          goTo(carousel, Number(carousel.dataset.index || '0') + 1);
          if(carousel.closest('.expedition-card')?.classList.contains('is-active')) startCarousel(carousel);
        });
      }

      carousel.querySelectorAll('.exp-carousel-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
          goTo(carousel, i);
          if(carousel.closest('.expedition-card')?.classList.contains('is-active')) startCarousel(carousel);
        });
      });

      carousel.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => stopCarousel(carousel));
      carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        if(carousel.closest('.expedition-card')?.classList.contains('is-active')) startCarousel(carousel);
      });
    });

    if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          const card = entry.target;
          const carousel = card.querySelector('.exp-carousel');

          if(entry.isIntersecting){
            cards.forEach(other => {
              if(other !== card){
                other.classList.remove('is-active');
                stopCarousel(other.querySelector('.exp-carousel'));
              }
            });

            card.classList.add('is-active');
            startCarousel(carousel);
          } else {
            card.classList.remove('is-active');
            stopCarousel(carousel);
          }
        });
      }, {
        root: null,
        rootMargin: '-34% 0px -34% 0px',
        threshold: 0
      });

      cards.forEach(card => observer.observe(card));
    } else {
      const first = cards[0];
      if(first){
        first.classList.add('is-active');
        startCarousel(first.querySelector('.exp-carousel'));
      }
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initExpeditionCarousels);
})();
</script>
```

```{r mapa-expedicoes}
library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)
library(sf)

# =========================================================================
# 1) CAMINHOS DE INPUT
# =========================================================================

find_existing_dir <- function(candidates) {
  for (rel in candidates) {
    hit <- find_up(rel)
    if (!is.na(hit) && dir.exists(hit)) return(hit)
  }
  NA_character_
}

find_existing_file <- function(candidates) {
  for (rel in candidates) {
    hit <- find_up(rel)
    if (!is.na(hit) && file.exists(hit)) return(hit)
  }
  NA_character_
}

kml_dir <- find_existing_dir(c(
  file.path("_input_data", "kml_expedições"),
  file.path("_input_data", "kml_expedicoes")
))

# O código aceita tanto uma pasta de coletas quanto o arquivo validado que
# aparece diretamente em _input_data.
project_dirs <- c(
  file.path("_input_data", "expedições"),
  file.path("_input_data", "expedicoes"),
  file.path("_input_data", "coletas_expedições"),
  file.path("_input_data", "coletas_expedicoes"),
  file.path("_input_data", "expedicoes_coletas")
)

project_direct_files <- c(
  file.path("_input_data", "dwc_expedicoes_tsiino_validado.xlsx"),
  file.path("_input_data", "dwc_expedicoes_tsiino.xlsx"),
  file.path("_input_data", "coletas_expedicoes.xlsx"),
  file.path("_input_data", "coletas_expedições.xlsx")
)

# =========================================================================
# 2) HELPERS PARA PLANILHAS E DWC
# =========================================================================

norm_name <- function(x) {
  x <- iconv(as.character(x), from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")
  x <- tolower(x)
  gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", x)
}

find_col_ci <- function(data, candidates, required = FALSE, label = NULL) {
  nms <- names(data)
  hit <- match(norm_name(candidates), norm_name(nms))
  hit <- hit[!is.na(hit)]

  if (length(hit) > 0) return(nms[hit[1]])

  if (required) {
    stop(
      "Não encontrei a coluna ",
      ifelse(is.null(label), paste(candidates, collapse = "/"), label),
      ". Colunas disponíveis: ", paste(nms, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  NA_character_
}

get_col_chr <- function(data, candidates) {
  col <- find_col_ci(data, candidates, required = FALSE)
  if (is.na(col)) return(rep(NA_character_, nrow(data)))
  as.character(data[[col]])
}

first_nonempty <- function(...) {
  xs <- list(...)
  if (length(xs) == 0) return(character())

  n <- max(vapply(xs, length, integer(1)))
  out <- rep(NA_character_, n)

  for (x in xs) {
    x <- rep_len(as.character(x), n)
    use <- !nz(out) & nz(x)
    out[use] <- x[use]
  }

  out
}

# Se o Darwin Core trouxer todos os coletores em recordedBy separados por
# ponto e vírgula, usa o primeiro como coletor principal e mantém os demais
# como coletores adicionais. O mesmo tratamento vale para uma coluna
# collector que eventualmente contenha a equipe inteira.
split_collectors <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  primary <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  additional <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))

  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    if (!nz(x[i])) next

    parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x[i], "\\s*;\\s*", perl = TRUE)))
    parts <- parts[nz(parts)]

    if (length(parts) > 0) primary[i] <- parts[1]
    if (length(parts) > 1) additional[i] <- paste(parts[-1], collapse = "; ")
  }

  list(primary = primary, additional = additional)
}

parse_coord_one <- function(value, hemi = NA_character_) {
  if (length(value) == 0 || is.na(value)) return(NA_real_)

  s <- trimws(as.character(value))
  if (!nzchar(s)) return(NA_real_)
  s <- gsub(",", ".", s, fixed = TRUE)

  direct <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(s))

  if (!is.na(direct)) {
    val <- direct
  } else {
    nums <- regmatches(
      s,
      gregexpr("-?[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?", s, perl = TRUE)
    )[[1]]

    if (length(nums) == 0 || identical(nums, character(0))) return(NA_real_)

    z <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(nums))
    z <- z[!is.na(z)]
    if (length(z) == 0) return(NA_real_)

    sign0 <- ifelse(z[1] < 0, -1, 1)
    z <- abs(z)

    val <- z[1]
    if (length(z) >= 2) val <- val + z[2] / 60
    if (length(z) >= 3) val <- val + z[3] / 3600
    val <- sign0 * val
  }

  hs <- toupper(trimws(as.character(hemi)))
  full <- toupper(s)

  if (
    (!is.na(hs) && hs %in% c("S", "W", "O")) ||
    grepl("(^|[^A-Z])(S|W|O)($|[^A-Z])", full)
  ) {
    val <- -abs(val)
  } else if (
    (!is.na(hs) && hs %in% c("N", "E", "L")) ||
    grepl("(^|[^A-Z])(N|E|L)($|[^A-Z])", full)
  ) {
    val <- abs(val)
  }

  val
}

parse_coord <- function(x, hemi = NULL) {
  if (is.null(hemi)) hemi <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  mapply(parse_coord_one, x, hemi, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

read_delimited_auto <- function(path) {
  first <- readLines(path, n = 1, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  if (length(first) == 0) return(data.frame())

  counts <- c(
    comma = lengths(regmatches(first, gregexpr(",", first, fixed = TRUE))),
    semicolon = lengths(regmatches(first, gregexpr(";", first, fixed = TRUE))),
    tab = lengths(regmatches(first, gregexpr("\t", first, fixed = TRUE)))
  )

  sep <- c(comma = ",", semicolon = ";", tab = "\t")[[names(which.max(counts))]]

  read.table(
    path,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = sep,
    quote = "\"",
    comment.char = "",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM",
    na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL"),
    fill = TRUE
  )
}

read_collection_file <- function(path) {
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))

  if (ext %in% c("xlsx", "xls")) {
    if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
      warning("Pacote 'readxl' não instalado; ignorando: ", basename(path))
      return(list())
    }

    sheets <- tryCatch(readxl::excel_sheets(path), error = function(e) character())
    if (length(sheets) == 0) return(list())

    out <- lapply(sheets, function(sh) {
      x <- tryCatch(
        readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = sh, .name_repair = "minimal"),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
      x <- as.data.frame(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
      attr(x, "source_sheet") <- sh
      x
    })

    return(Filter(Negate(is.null), out))
  }

  if (ext %in% c("csv", "tsv", "txt")) {
    x <- tryCatch(read_delimited_auto(path), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(x)) return(list())
    attr(x, "source_sheet") <- NA_character_
    return(list(x))
  }

  list()
}

make_date_from_parts <- function(data) {
  dd <- get_col_chr(data, c("colldd", "day", "dia", "eventday"))
  mm <- get_col_chr(data, c("collmm", "month", "mes", "mês", "eventmonth"))
  yy <- get_col_chr(data, c("collyy", "year", "ano", "eventyear"))

  have_any <- nz(dd) | nz(mm) | nz(yy)
  out <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(data))

  if (any(have_any)) {
    dd_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(dd))
    mm_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(mm))

    out[have_any] <- paste(
      ifelse(nz(dd[have_any]) & !is.na(dd_num[have_any]), sprintf("%02d", dd_num[have_any]), "??"),
      ifelse(nz(mm[have_any]) & !is.na(mm_num[have_any]), sprintf("%02d", mm_num[have_any]), "??"),
      ifelse(nz(yy[have_any]), yy[have_any], "????"),
      sep = "/"
    )
  }

  out
}

make_taxon_from_parts <- function(data) {
  genus <- get_col_chr(data, c("genus", "genero", "gênero"))
  sp <- get_col_chr(data, c("specificEpithet", "sp1", "species", "especie", "espécie"))
  out <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(data))
  ok <- nz(genus) | nz(sp)
  out[ok] <- trimws(paste(
    ifelse(nz(genus[ok]), genus[ok], ""),
    ifelse(nz(sp[ok]), sp[ok], "")
  ))
  out[!nz(out)] <- NA_character_
  out
}

standardize_collection <- function(data, source_kind, source_label, source_file, source_sheet = NA_character_) {
  if (is.null(data) || nrow(data) == 0) return(NULL)

  lat_col <- find_col_ci(
    data,
    c("decimalLatitude", "decimal_latitude", "latitude", "lat", "verbatimLatitude", "y")
  )

  lon_col <- find_col_ci(
    data,
    c("decimalLongitude", "decimal_longitude", "longitude", "lon", "long", "lng", "verbatimLongitude", "x")
  )

  if (is.na(lat_col) || is.na(lon_col)) return(NULL)

  ns <- get_col_chr(data, c("NS", "latHemisphere", "latitudeHemisphere"))
  ew <- get_col_chr(data, c("EW", "longHemisphere", "lonHemisphere", "longitudeHemisphere"))

  collector_raw <- first_nonempty(
    get_col_chr(data, c("collector", "coletor", "collectorName", "primaryCollector")),
    get_col_chr(data, c("recordedBy")),
    get_col_chr(data, c("collectors"))
  )

  collector_parts <- split_collectors(collector_raw)
  collector <- collector_parts$primary

  additional_collectors <- first_nonempty(
    get_col_chr(data, c(
      "addcoll", "additionalCollectors", "additionalCollector",
      "associatedCollectors", "coletores_adicionais", "coletores adicionais",
      "additional_collectors"
    )),
    collector_parts$additional
  )

  number <- first_nonempty(
    get_col_chr(data, c("recordNumber")),
    get_col_chr(data, c("number", "numero", "número", "numero_coleta", "collectionNumber", "fieldNumber")),
    get_col_chr(data, c("catalogNumber"))
  )

  locality <- first_nonempty(
    get_col_chr(data, c("locality", "localidade")),
    get_col_chr(data, c("verbatimLocality", "locnotes")),
    get_col_chr(data, c("gazetteer")),
    get_col_chr(data, c("minorarea", "municipality", "municipio", "município"))
  )

  event_date <- first_nonempty(
    get_col_chr(data, c("eventDate", "event_date")),
    get_col_chr(data, c("date", "data", "collectionDate")),
    make_date_from_parts(data)
  )

  scientific_name <- first_nonempty(
    get_col_chr(data, c("scientificName", "scientific_name", "currentFullSpeciesName", "Corrected Full Species Name")),
    make_taxon_from_parts(data)
  )

  family <- first_nonempty(
    get_col_chr(data, c("family", "familia", "família", "currentFamily", "Corrected Family"))
  )

  habitat <- first_nonempty(
    get_col_chr(data, c("habitat", "habitattxt", "habitatText"))
  )

  remarks <- first_nonempty(
    get_col_chr(data, c("occurrenceRemarks", "plantdesc", "notes", "observacoes", "observações", "remarks"))
  )

  institution <- first_nonempty(
    get_col_chr(data, c("institutionCode", "institution", "herbarium", "collectionCode"))
  )

  catalog_number <- first_nonempty(
    get_col_chr(data, c("catalogNumber", "accession", "barcode"))
  )

  expedition <- first_nonempty(
    get_col_chr(data, c("expedition", "expedicao", "expedição", "campaign", "campanha"))
  )

  out <- data.frame(
    latitude = parse_coord(data[[lat_col]], ns),
    longitude = parse_coord(data[[lon_col]], ew),
    collector = collector,
    additional_collectors = additional_collectors,
    number = number,
    locality = locality,
    event_date = event_date,
    scientific_name = scientific_name,
    family = family,
    habitat = habitat,
    remarks = remarks,
    institution = institution,
    catalog_number = catalog_number,
    expedition = expedition,
    source_kind = source_kind,
    source_label = source_label,
    source_file = basename(source_file),
    source_sheet = rep_len(source_sheet, nrow(data)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Corrige longitudes amazônicas sem sinal quando claramente informadas como oeste.
  out$longitude <- ifelse(
    !is.na(out$longitude) & out$longitude > 0 & out$longitude <= 80,
    -out$longitude,
    out$longitude
  )

  out <- out[
    !is.na(out$latitude) &
      !is.na(out$longitude) &
      out$latitude >= -90 & out$latitude <= 90 &
      out$longitude >= -180 & out$longitude <= 180,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(NULL)
  out
}

collect_input_files <- function(dir_candidates, direct_candidates) {
  out <- character()

  for (rel in dir_candidates) {
    d <- find_up(rel)
    if (!is.na(d) && dir.exists(d)) {
      out <- c(
        out,
        list.files(
          d,
          pattern = "\\.(xlsx|xls|csv|tsv|txt)$",
          full.names = TRUE,
          recursive = TRUE,
          ignore.case = TRUE
        )
      )
    }
  }

  for (rel in direct_candidates) {
    f <- find_up(rel)
    if (!is.na(f) && file.exists(f)) out <- c(out, f)
  }

  out <- unique(out)
  out <- out[!grepl("(^|[/\\\\])~\\$", out)]
  out
}

read_collection_files <- function(files, source_kind, source_label) {
  if (length(files) == 0) return(data.frame())

  all_rows <- list()
  k <- 0L

  for (f in files) {
    tables <- read_collection_file(f)
    if (length(tables) == 0) next

    for (tb in tables) {
      z <- standardize_collection(
        tb,
        source_kind = source_kind,
        source_label = source_label,
        source_file = f,
        source_sheet = attr(tb, "source_sheet")
      )

      if (!is.null(z) && nrow(z) > 0) {
        k <- k + 1L
        all_rows[[k]] <- z
      }
    }
  }

  if (length(all_rows) == 0) return(data.frame())
  dplyr::bind_rows(all_rows)
}

read_one_kml <- function(path) {
  layers <- tryCatch(sf::st_layers(path)$name, error = function(e) character())
  if (length(layers) == 0) return(NULL)

  parts <- lapply(layers, function(layer_name) {
    x <- tryCatch(
      sf::st_read(path, layer = layer_name, quiet = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) return(NULL)

    x <- tryCatch(sf::st_transform(x, 4326), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)

    x <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_zm(x, drop = TRUE, what = "ZM"))
    geom_type <- as.character(sf::st_geometry_type(x))
    x <- x[geom_type %in% c("LINESTRING", "MULTILINESTRING"), , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(x) == 0) return(NULL)

    sf::st_sf(
      kml_name = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path)),
      kml_file = basename(path),
      geometry = sf::st_geometry(x)
    )
  })

  parts <- Filter(Negate(is.null), parts)
  if (length(parts) == 0) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind, parts)
}

    pattern = "\\.kml$",

    recursive = FALSE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
} else {
  character()
}

trail_list <- lapply(kml_files, read_one_kml)

make_collection_label <- function(number, collector) {
  number <- as.character(number)
  collector <- as.character(collector)

  if (nz(number)) return(number)
  if (nz(collector)) return(collector)
  "Coleta"
}

popup_row <- function(label, value) {
  value <- as.character(value)[1]
  if (!nz(value)) return("")
  paste0(
    "<tr><td class='popup-k'>", safe_html(label), "</td>",
    "<td class='popup-v'>", safe_html(value), "</td></tr>"
  )
}

make_collection_popup <- function(data) {
  if (nrow(data) == 0) return(character())

  vapply(seq_len(nrow(data)), function(i) {
    x <- data[i, , drop = FALSE]

    has_taxon <- nz(x$scientific_name)
    title_html <- if (has_taxon) {
      paste0("<em>", safe_html(x$scientific_name), "</em>")
    } else {
      "Coleta botânica"
    }

    title_class <- if (has_taxon) "popup-title popup-taxon" else "popup-title"

    paste0(
      "<div class='popup-card'>",
      "<div class='", title_class, "'>", title_html, "</div>",
      if (nz(x$family)) paste0("<div class='popup-family'>", safe_html(x$family), "</div>") else "",
      "<table class='popup-table'>",
      popup_row("Coletor principal", x$collector),
      popup_row("Coletores adicionais", x$additional_collectors),
      popup_row("Número", x$number),
      popup_row("Localidade", x$locality),
      popup_row("Data", x$event_date),
      popup_row("Expedição", x$expedition),
      popup_row("Habitat", x$habitat),
      popup_row("Características", x$remarks),
      popup_row("Instituição", x$institution),
      popup_row("Catálogo", x$catalog_number),
      "</table>",
      "<div class='popup-source'>", safe_html(x$source_label),
      if (nz(x$source_file)) paste0(" · ", safe_html(x$source_file)) else "",
      "</div>",
      "</div>"
    )
  }, character(1))
}

    "<div class='legend-row'><span class='line' style='border-top-color:#D99A27;'></span><span>São Gabriel da Cachoeira</span></div>"
  } else "",
  trail_legend_html,
  if (nrow(project_points) > 0) {
    paste0(
      "<div class='legend-row'><span class='dot' style='background:#A93632;'></span>",
      "<span>Coletas do projeto (n = ", nrow(project_points), ")</span></div>"
    )
  } else "",
  "<div class='legend-row' style='margin-top:.42rem;color:#675F55;'>",
  "Clique em um agrupamento numerado para aproximar; no zoom máximo, o grupo abre as coletas sobrepostas.",
  "</div>",
  "</div>",
  "</details>"
)

map <- map %>%
  addControl(
    html = legend_html,
    position = "bottomright",
    className = "map-legend-control"
  )


# Heatmap suave por escala + modo ponto/contagem + números das coletas em
# escala próxima + controle de tela cheia. O mapa continua funcionando se
# o plugin de heatmap não estiver disponível.
heat_payload <- if (nrow(collection_points) > 0) {
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(collection_points)), function(i) {
    list(
      as.numeric(collection_points$latitude[i]),
      as.numeric(collection_points$longitude[i]),
      1
    )
  })
} else {
  list()
}

map <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  map,
  "
  function(el, x, data) {
    var map = this;
    var container = map.getContainer();
    var heat = null;
    var clusterGroup = null;

    function findClusterGroup(){
      if(clusterGroup) return clusterGroup;
      Object.keys(map._layers || {}).some(function(k){
        var layer = map._layers[k];
        if(layer && typeof layer.getAllChildMarkers === 'function' &&
           typeof layer.refreshClusters === 'function'){
          clusterGroup = layer;
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      });
      return clusterGroup;
    }

    if(window.L && typeof L.heatLayer === 'function' &&
       data && data.heat && data.heat.length){
      heat = L.heatLayer(data.heat, {
        radius: 25,
        blur: 22,
        maxZoom: 10,
        minOpacity: 0.10,
        gradient: {
          0.20: '#6E1F1D',
          0.48: '#A93632',
          0.72: '#C46A2A',
          1.00: '#D99A27'
        }
      }).addTo(map);

      if(heat._canvas){
        heat._canvas.classList.add('tsiino-heat-layer');
      }
    }

    function closeCollectionLabels(group){
      if(!group) return;
      group.eachLayer(function(layer){
        if(layer && typeof layer.closeTooltip === 'function'){
          layer.closeTooltip();
        }
      });
    }

    function showVisibleCollectionLabels(group){
      if(!group) return;
      group.eachLayer(function(layer){
        if(layer && typeof layer.openTooltip === 'function' && map.hasLayer(layer)){
          layer.openTooltip();
        }
      });
    }

    function syncZoomMode(){
      var z = map.getZoom();

      container.classList.remove('zoom-heat', 'zoom-points', 'zoom-counts');

      if(z <= 6){
        container.classList.add('zoom-heat');
      } else if(z <= 10){
        container.classList.add('zoom-points');
      } else {
        container.classList.add('zoom-counts');
      }

      if(heat){
        if(z <= 9){
          if(!map.hasLayer(heat)) heat.addTo(map);
          if(heat._canvas){
            heat._canvas.classList.add('tsiino-heat-layer');
            heat._canvas.style.opacity =
              z <= 6 ? '0.62' :
              z === 7 ? '0.40' :
              z === 8 ? '0.22' : '0.10';
          }
        } else if(map.hasLayer(heat)){
          map.removeLayer(heat);
        }
      }

      var group = findClusterGroup();
      if(group){
        if(typeof group.refreshClusters === 'function'){
          group.refreshClusters();
        }

        closeCollectionLabels(group);

        // Nas escalas mais próximas, os pontos individuais exibem o
        // identificador da coleta. Registros ainda sobrepostos continuam
        // como agrupamento e podem ser abertos com clique.
        if(z >= 15){
          window.setTimeout(function(){
            showVisibleCollectionLabels(group);
          }, 80);
        }
      }
    }

    map.on('zoomend moveend', syncZoomMode);

    var group = findClusterGroup();
    if(group){
      group.on('spiderfied', function(){
        window.setTimeout(syncZoomMode, 120);
      });
      group.on('unspiderfied', function(){
        window.setTimeout(syncZoomMode, 120);
      });
      group.on('animationend', function(){
        window.setTimeout(syncZoomMode, 40);
      });
    }

    // Controle de tela cheia usando a API nativa do navegador.
    if(!container.querySelector('.tsiino-fullscreen-control')){
      var FullscreenControl = L.Control.extend({
        options: { position: 'topleft' },
        onAdd: function(){
          var wrap = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar tsiino-fullscreen-control');
          var button = L.DomUtil.create('a', '', wrap);
          button.href = '#';
          button.innerHTML = '&#x26F6;';
          button.title = 'Abrir mapa em tela cheia';
          button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Abrir mapa em tela cheia');
          button.setAttribute('role', 'button');

          L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(wrap);
          L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(wrap);

          L.DomEvent.on(button, 'click', function(ev){
            L.DomEvent.stop(ev);

            var isNativeFull =
              document.fullscreenElement === container ||
              document.webkitFullscreenElement === container;

            if(isNativeFull){
              if(document.exitFullscreen) document.exitFullscreen();
              else if(document.webkitExitFullscreen) document.webkitExitFullscreen();
              return;
            }

            if(container.classList.contains('tsiino-faux-fullscreen')){
              container.classList.remove('tsiino-faux-fullscreen');
              document.body.classList.remove('tsiino-map-fullscreen');
              window.setTimeout(function(){ map.invalidateSize(); }, 80);
              return;
            }

            if(container.requestFullscreen){
              container.requestFullscreen();
            } else if(container.webkitRequestFullscreen){
              container.webkitRequestFullscreen();
            } else {
              container.classList.add('tsiino-faux-fullscreen');
              document.body.classList.add('tsiino-map-fullscreen');
              window.setTimeout(function(){ map.invalidateSize(); }, 80);
            }
          });

          return wrap;
        }
      });

      map.addControl(new FullscreenControl());
    }

    function afterFullscreenChange(){
      window.setTimeout(function(){
        map.invalidateSize();
        syncZoomMode();
      }, 100);
    }

    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', afterFullscreenChange);
    document.addEventListener('webkitfullscreenchange', afterFullscreenChange);

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(ev){
      if(ev.key === 'Escape' && container.classList.contains('tsiino-faux-fullscreen')){
        container.classList.remove('tsiino-faux-fullscreen');
        document.body.classList.remove('tsiino-map-fullscreen');
        window.setTimeout(function(){ map.invalidateSize(); }, 80);
      }
    });

    window.setTimeout(function(){
      map.invalidateSize();
      syncZoomMode();
    }, 180);
  }
  ",
  data = list(heat = heat_payload)
)

map
```

```{r expedition-sections}
library(htmltools)

# =========================================================================
# METADADOS DAS EXPEDIÇÕES — mantêm a lógica antiga das fotos/cards.
# Este arquivo NÃO alimenta mais os pontos do mapa.
# =========================================================================

exp_meta_path <- find_up(file.path("_input_data", "expedicoes_tsiino.csv"))
photo_root_abs <- find_up(file.path("_input_data", "expedicoes_fotos"))
photo_root_html_rel <- file.path("..", "_input_data", "expedicoes_fotos")

read_expedition_metadata <- function(path) {
  if (is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) return(data.frame())

  raw <- tryCatch(read_delimited_auto(path), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(raw) || nrow(raw) == 0) return(data.frame())

  get_meta <- function(candidates) get_col_chr(raw, candidates)

  out <- data.frame(
    expedicao = first_nonempty(
      get_meta(c("expedicao", "expedição", "expedition", "nome", "name"))
    ),
    input_id = first_nonempty(
      get_meta(c("expedicao_id", "expedição_id", "id", "slug", "codigo", "código"))
    ),
    localidade = first_nonempty(
      get_meta(c("localidade", "local", "site", "ponto", "locality"))
    ),
    data_exp = first_nonempty(
      get_meta(c("data", "date", "periodo", "período"))
    ),
    comunidade = first_nonempty(
      get_meta(c("comunidade", "community", "aldeia"))
    ),
    municipio = first_nonempty(
      get_meta(c("municipio", "município", "city", "cidade"))
    ),
    equipe = first_nonempty(
      get_meta(c("equipe", "team", "pesquisadores", "coletores", "collectors"))
    ),
    observacoes = first_nonempty(
      get_meta(c("observacoes", "observações", "obs", "notes", "comentarios", "comentários"))
    ),
    resumo = first_nonempty(
      get_meta(c("resumo", "descricao", "descrição", "description"))
    ),
    pasta_fotos = clean_photo_folder(first_nonempty(
      get_meta(c("pasta_fotos", "fotos", "folder", "photo_folder", "pasta", "imagens"))
    )),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out$expedicao[!nz(out$expedicao)] <- paste0("Expedição ", which(!nz(out$expedicao)))

  ids <- out$input_id
  ids[!nz(ids)] <- out$expedicao[!nz(ids)]
  out$expedicao_id <- slugify(ids)
  out$section_id <- paste0("exp-", out$expedicao_id)

  out$pasta_fotos[!nz(out$pasta_fotos)] <- out$expedicao_id[!nz(out$pasta_fotos)]
  out
}

expedicoes <- read_expedition_metadata(exp_meta_path)

# Fallback: se o CSV ainda não existir, cada subpasta de expedicoes_fotos
# vira uma expedição para que a galeria continue funcionando.
if (nrow(expedicoes) == 0 && !is.na(photo_root_abs) && dir.exists(photo_root_abs)) {
  folders <- list.dirs(photo_root_abs, recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
  folders <- folders[nz(folders)]

  if (length(folders) > 0) {
    titles <- gsub("[-_]", " ", folders)
    titles <- tools::toTitleCase(titles)

    expedicoes <- data.frame(
      expedicao = titles,
      input_id = folders,
      localidade = NA_character_,
      data_exp = NA_character_,
      comunidade = NA_character_,
      municipio = NA_character_,
      equipe = NA_character_,
      observacoes = NA_character_,
      resumo = NA_character_,
      pasta_fotos = folders,
      expedicao_id = slugify(folders),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    expedicoes$section_id <- paste0("exp-", expedicoes$expedicao_id)
  }
}

get_photos <- function(folder) {
  folder <- clean_photo_folder(folder)[1]

  if (is.na(photo_root_abs) || is.na(folder) || !nzchar(folder)) {
    return(character())
  }

  d <- file.path(photo_root_abs, folder)
  if (!dir.exists(d)) return(character())

  f <- list.files(
    d,
    pattern = "\\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$",
    full.names = FALSE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  f <- f[!grepl("^\\.", f)]
  if (length(f) == 0) return(character())

  f <- sort(f)
  gsub("\\\\", "/", file.path(photo_root_html_rel, folder, f))
}

make_meta <- function(label, value, key = NULL) {
  value <- as.character(value)[1]
  if (!nz(value)) return(NULL)

  if (!is.null(key) && nzchar(key)) {
    tags$span(
      class = "meta-pill",
      tags$span(`data-i18n` = key, label),
      ": ",
      value
    )
  } else {
    tags$span(class = "meta-pill", paste0(label, ": ", value))
  }
}

make_gallery <- function(photos, title, section_id) {
  if (length(photos) == 0) {
    return(
      tags$div(
        class = "empty-gallery",
        tags$span(`data-i18n` = "expeditions.card.noPhoto", "Nenhuma foto encontrada para esta expedição.")
      )
    )
  }

  slides <- lapply(seq_along(photos), function(j) {
    tags$figure(
      class = "exp-slide",
      tags$img(
        src = photos[j],
        alt = paste(title, "foto", j),
        loading = if (j == 1) "eager" else "lazy",
        decoding = "async"
      ),
      tags$figcaption(
        tagList(
          tags$span(`data-i18n` = "common.photo", "Foto"),
          " ", j, " · ", title
        )
      )
    )
  })

  dots <- lapply(seq_along(photos), function(j) {
    tags$button(
      class = paste("exp-carousel-dot", if (j == 1) "is-current" else ""),
      type = "button",
      `aria-label` = paste("Ir para foto", j),
      `aria-current` = if (j == 1) "true" else "false"
    )
  })

  tags$div(
    class = "exp-carousel",
    id = paste0("carousel-", section_id),
    `data-index` = "0",
    `data-single` = if (length(photos) == 1) "true" else "false",
    tags$div(class = "exp-carousel-track", do.call(tagList, slides)),
    tags$button(
      class = "exp-carousel-nav exp-carousel-prev",
      type = "button",
      `aria-label` = "Foto anterior",
      "‹"
    ),
    tags$button(
      class = "exp-carousel-nav exp-carousel-next",
      type = "button",
      `aria-label` = "Próxima foto",
      "›"
    ),
    tags$div(class = "exp-carousel-dots", do.call(tagList, dots))
  )
}

make_exp_card <- function(i) {
  x <- expedicoes[i, , drop = FALSE]
  photos <- get_photos(x$pasta_fotos)

  title <- ifelse(
    nz(x$expedicao),
    x$expedicao,
    paste0("Expedição ", i)
  )

  summary_txt <- ifelse(
    nz(x$resumo),
    x$resumo,
    x$observacoes
  )

  tags$section(
    class = "expedition-card",
    id = x$section_id,
    tags$div(
      class = "expedition-eyebrow",
      `data-i18n` = "expeditions.card.eyebrow",
      "Expedição"
    ),
    tags$h3(title),
    tags$div(
      class = "expedition-meta",
      make_meta("Data", x$data_exp, "common.date"),
      make_meta("Localidade", x$localidade, "common.locality"),
      make_meta("Comunidade", x$comunidade, "common.community"),
      make_meta("Município", x$municipio, "common.municipality"),
      make_meta("Equipe", x$equipe, "common.team")
    ),
    if (nz(summary_txt)) tags$p(class = "expedition-summary", summary_txt),
    make_gallery(photos, title, x$section_id)
  )
}

make_page_break <- function(position_index) {
  n <- ((position_index - 1) %% 5) + 1
  filename <- if (n == 1) "page_break.jpg" else paste0("page_break_", n, ".jpg")

  tags$figure(
    class = "expedition-break",
    `aria-hidden` = "true",
    tags$img(
      src = file.path("..", "figures", filename),
      alt = "",
      loading = "lazy",
      decoding = "async",
      onerror = "this.closest('.expedition-break').style.display='none';"
    )
  )
}

if (nrow(expedicoes) > 0) {
  items <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(expedicoes))) {
    items[[length(items) + 1]] <- make_exp_card(i)

    if (i < nrow(expedicoes)) {
      items[[length(items) + 1]] <- make_page_break(i)
    }
  }

  tagList(
    tags$div(
      class = "expedition-grid",
      do.call(tagList, items)
    )
  )
} else {
  tags$div(
    class = "expedition-card",
    tags$p(
      `data-i18n` = "expeditions.list.empty",
      "Nenhuma expedição foi cadastrada em _input_data/expedicoes_tsiino.csv e nenhuma subpasta foi encontrada em _input_data/expedicoes_fotos/."
    )
  )
}
```
